summary_rationale: Tanfac Industries exhibits a genuine regulatory and hazardous-logistics moat at its 54-year-old coastal SIPCOT Cuddalore complex, reinforced by co-promoter Anupam Rasayan's strategic backing, successful doubling of AHF capacity to 29,700 MTPA (Oct 2024), first-mover domestic commissioning of 10,000 TPA Solar-Grade DHF (Oct 2025), and a 7-year ₹2,362.5 crore Japanese supply contract anchoring 37.5% of its ₹495 crore, 20,000 MTPA R-32/fluorinated chemicals expansion. However, the business remains structurally cyclical and conditional: it is 100% reliant on imported acid-grade fluorspar, operates from a single regulated Cuddalore site, saw operating margins compress from 24% (FY25) to 16% (FY26) and 12% (Sep 2026 quarter), and experienced weaker CFO-to-EBITDA conversion (47–56%) alongside negative Free Cash Flow (-₹39 Cr in FY26) and a 115-day Cash Conversion Cycle.
